# Tavra

> Tavra is a restaurant AI phone operations platform that answers calls and turns restaurant phone conversations into handled workflows: to-go orders, secure checkout, menu questions, reservation requests, custom caller answers, routing, notes, and staff-facing operations.

Tavra is a restaurant AI phone operations platform. It is built for restaurants that need phone calls to become handled workflows, not mystery voicemails or generic chatbot conversations.

## What Tavra Does

- Answers restaurant phone calls.
- Handles phone workflows for to-go orders, secure checkout, menu questions, reservation requests, custom caller questions, routing, notes, and staff or owner notifications.
- Supports a Native Tavra Reservation Book for restaurants that need a Tavra-owned reservation workflow.
- Creates staff-facing Operations records and supports System Fallback behavior that separates local store-device outages, provider API/auth failures, and kitchen printer status after an order is accepted.
- Lets restaurants control how autonomous the agent should be by workflow.

## Truthful Integration Status

Tavra public pages must distinguish active Tavra workflow capabilities from integration-ready, planned, approval-dependent, or future third-party connection paths. Do not infer live provider approval, marketplace availability, POS injection, or reservation-system sync unless a current public page explicitly says it is available and the repo contract permits that claim.
